stage0095_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「They're standing by in the rear to defend $$アクシズ$$」

stage0095_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$レズン$$
「You're awfully on edge, Enhanced Human」

stage0095_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$レズン$$
「Your princess is stuck in the rear,
　all thanks to the Supreme Commander's favor.
　Does that bother you?」

stage0095_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$レズン$$
「Or is it that you can't forgive
　what the Supreme Commander's trying to do?」

stage0095_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「What about you, $$レズン・シュナイダー$$?」

stage0095_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$レズン$$
「...Well, smashing the Earth to pieces
　was more than I bargained for, I'll admit」

stage0095_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$レズン$$
「But it's satisfying, isn't it, giving a shock
　to people who think of colonists as nothing
　more than their own servants?」

stage0095_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...So it's revenge, in other words.
　Dragging in people who have nothing to do with the war...」

stage0095_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$レズン$$
「I heard about it.
　Your parents, who lived in a colony...
　died in the $$一年戦争$$, didn't they」

stage0095_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$レズン$$
「Don't get so angry, Enhanced Human」

stage0095_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$レズン$$
「No such thing.
　Compared to before, you've become a better person, after all」

stage0095_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$レズン$$
「You're not that damn cocky elite anymore,
　acting all high and mighty about being an Enhanced Human」

stage0095_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$レズン$$
「Guess that $c of yours
　was one comfortable place to be, huh」

stage0095_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$レズン$$
「That's what makes you human.
　...But don't think about anything extra.
　They're the enemy」

stage0095_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「We've confirmed $$アクシズ$$ and Neo Zeon」

stage0095_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Also, the Federation fleet led by Brigadier General
　$$サイガス・エイロニー$$ appears to be watching the situation」

stage0095_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It seems they intend to let us handle Neo Zeon
　while they preserve their own strength」

stage0095_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Or perhaps, depending on the situation,
　they mean to wipe out both Neo Zeon and us
　together...」

stage0095_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「$$ラー・カイラム$$ and $$ネェル・アーガマ$$
　will be joining this ship as well」

stage0095_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「Aye, ma'am!
　All mobile units, launch!」

stage0095_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Is $$シャア・アズナブル$$ not out there?」

stage0095_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Is $$シャア$$ really going to drop $$アクシズ$$ on Earth...」

stage0095_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$キラ$$
「We can only ask him for that answer」

stage0095_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$シン$$
「That's exactly why we're crushing Neo Zeon!」

stage0095_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$レズン$$
「Look who's talking.
　Treating us like the opening act!」

stage0095_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$レズン$$
「Here we go, $$ギュネイ$$!
　I'll make those big mouths regret it!」

stage0095_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$クェス$$... where are you...」

stage0095_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$カツ$$
「Let's do this, $$ハサウェイ$$!
　If we don't survive, we can't see $$クェス$$ again!」

stage0095_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Captain Testarossa, leave the rest to us.
　Take the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ to the rear」

stage0095_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「No... we've trained again and again
　for space combat, for this very day.
　We won't be a burden」

stage0095_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Above all, settling things with Neo Zeon here
　is the unanimous will of this ship's crew」

stage0095_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Understood.
　We're grateful for your ship's cooperation」

stage0095_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units!
　Hit the frontline forces and
　drag $$シャア・アズナブル$$ out!」

stage0095_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ネェル・アーガマ$$, $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$,
　follow the $$ラー・カイラム$$!
　We're engaging in a fleet battle!」

stage0095_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$オットー$$
「Of course!
　I too am a member of Londo Bell's... $c!」

stage0095_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「On Earth, the truth about $$エタニティ・フラット$$
　will soon be made public」

stage0095_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「So by the time this battle's over,
　every last human will be forced to choose their future」

stage0095_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Mobile units, cover the ships!
　Hit the enemy vessels and close in on $$アクシズ$$!」

stage0095_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アムロ$$
（I'm going to hear it, $$シャア$$...!
　Your true intentions...）

stage0095_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$c, begin the attack!
　We settle things with Neo Zeon here!」

stage0095_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Damn it!
　I'm sorry, $$クェス$$!!」

stage0095_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$フォウ$$
「It's all right, $$カミーユ$$.
　He ejected safely」

stage0095_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But he was someone I couldn't ignore」

stage0095_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$シン$$
「You know how tough he is, don't you?
　He's sure to be fine」

stage0095_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ブライト$$
「We've crushed the enemy's core strength.
　The front line will collapse entirely now」

stage0095_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$シャア$$
「So this day has finally come...」

stage0095_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$五飛$$
「Don't put on airs, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

stage0095_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「A war to overthrow the Earth Federation Forces
　controlled by Chrono... Even so,
　we reject your methods!」

stage0095_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's nothing but a trivial goal」

stage0095_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$刹那$$
「Then I'll have you tell me!
　Your reason for starting this war!」

stage0095_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What meaning is there in a war
　$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ pulled the strings on...!?」

stage0095_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$シャア$$
「...I started this war
　so that humanity could overcome its wall」

stage0095_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$シャア$$
「An Earth that lets itself be led along
　by Geminis's scheme, choosing its own
　self-destruction, has no future worth speaking of」

stage0095_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$キラ$$
「Are you saying it's fine if humanity perishes?」

stage0095_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$シャア$$
「This war is to find that out」

stage0095_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$シン$$
「What kind of person are you!
　Just who do you think you are!?」

stage0095_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is that something one single person gets to decide!?」

stage0095_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Answer me!
　Do you call yourself $$シャア・アズナブル$$ and
　think you've become the one who judges humanity!?」

stage0095_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Just what are you planning to do!?」

stage0095_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$シモン$$
「Do you get it!?
　If something like that falls to Earth,
　it'll be a disaster!」

stage0095_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$リディ$$
「Even the direct impact alone dwarfs a Colony Drop!
　It'll trigger disasters on the scale of natural catastrophes!」

stage0095_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$バナージ$$
「And dust and ash will be thrown up
　into the upper atmosphere, blocking sunlight,
　bringing an endless winter to the surface...!」

stage0095_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The whole global environment would change!」

stage0095_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$甲児$$
「If that happens, Earth will become a dead planet!」

stage0095_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What for!?
　Are you trying to break the Prison of Time
　with the shock of the impact!?」

stage0095_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's not it, $$カミーユ$$.
　What I want is for humanity to advance
　to its next stage」

stage0095_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$シャア$$
「By moving the sphere of human life into space,
　that sense expands, and in adapting to it,
　they'll reach mutual understanding beyond misunderstanding...」

stage0095_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$バナージ$$
「The concept of... a Newtype...」

stage0095_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$シャア$$
「That idea isn't limited to $$ＵＣＷ$$'s Newtypes.
　The Innovators of $$ＡＤＷ$$, for example, are the same」

stage0095_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's not all.
　Lost wild instinct, Element ability, Spiral Power,
　such powers are humanity's new strength too」

stage0095_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「That ticks me off!
　So folks like me and $$赤木$$, who don't have
　that stuff, are just worthless, huh!」

stage0095_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$ワッ太$$'s right!
　New power or whatever you call it,
　what you're trying to do is just plain violence!」

stage0095_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$五飛$$
「You've gone too far, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　You force your ideals onto the world, and
　feel self-satisfied just for daring to wear that disgrace!」

stage0095_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Neither the world nor we
　have the slightest intention of humoring your ego!」

stage0095_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Why do you mean to walk the same path as $$トレーズ$$!
　He told you to find another way, didn't he!」

stage0095_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「A man of your caliber,
　why would you choose the same foolish means
　as $$トレーズ$$ or I!?」

stage0095_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「No! Before that!
　Why did you try to do something like this alone!?
　You must have had comrades... allies!」

stage0095_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The world is bigger than you think!
　Why did you try to carry it alone!?」

stage0095_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Is that because you're a singularity?」

stage0095_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$ is a singularity...!?」

stage0095_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$シャア$$...
　Did you use the Zero System because
　you harbored anxiety and fear toward the future?」

stage0095_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「When did you realize you were a singularity?
　Is that why you broke our ceasefire agreement,
　deciding to change the world with your own power?」

stage0095_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$シャア$$
「...I have no intention of answering.」

stage0095_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$シャア$$
「I'm counting on you, $$クェス$$.」

stage0095_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$クェス$$
「No...!
　I decided to be the Colonel's strength!
　To help carry even a little of what he bears!」

stage0095_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$クェス$$
「I'll avenge $$ギュネイ$$, just watch!」

stage0095_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Stop it, $$クェス$$!
　$$シャア$$ is using you as a tool of war!」

stage0095_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$クェス$$
「That's not true...!
　I... believed the Colonel would change the world!
　That's why I fight!」

stage0095_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$クェス$$
「With this Alpha, the one the Colonel gave me!」

stage0095_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$葵$$
「Not gonna happen, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　Don't tell me you forgot we stopped
　a falling moon before!」

stage0095_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$シモン$$
「A hunk of rock like that? My drill will smash it!」

stage0095_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「First, I'll make $$シャア$$ tell us everything.」

stage0095_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...Very well, $$アムロ$$.
　Then you're the one who'll stop $$シャア$$.」

stage0095_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「If you have time to apologize, hurry!
　Before this becomes something we can't undo!」

stage0095_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$シャア$$
「...It's because you're all there
　that I can pull something like this off...」

stage0095_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$シャア$$
「Here I come, $$アムロ$$... $c.
　If you'd deny me, then stop me yourself.」

stage0095_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$バナージ$$
「But, if that person really is a singularity...」

stage0095_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「All the more reason!
　We'll stop him right here!」

stage0095_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「This ridiculous crusade to fix the world,
　trying to carry it all on his own,
　I'll stop it all and repair spacetime!」

stage0095_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's right, $$カミーユ$$!
　But as long as I go by $$シャア・アズナブル$$,
　I'm not the man you knew!」

stage0095_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$シャア$$
「Even this 'ridiculous' act, I've resolved myself to it!」

stage0095_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, target Neo Zeon Supreme Commander $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　Stop him and bring the whole truth to light!」

stage0095_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$シャア$$
「Let's settle this!
　To my own past... and to this world's future!!」

stage0095_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$シャア$$
「If you can't even beat someone like me,
　know that despair awaits you!!」

stage0095_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$クェス$$
「I won't let you touch the Colonel, $$アムロ$$!」

stage0095_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't have time for children!」

stage0095_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$カツ$$
「It's alright, Hasa.
　$$クェス$$ has ejected.」

stage0095_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
（$$クェス$$... please, don't fight anymore...
　You shouldn't be doing something like this...）

stage0095_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Running away, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!?」

stage0095_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「You will take responsibility for this war!」

stage0095_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

stage0095_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$リディ$$
「What a sorry sight...!
　That's the man they called the Red Comet!?」

stage0095_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Does this mean... the war with Neo Zeon is finally over...」

stage0095_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$エマ$$
「Watch out!
　$$アクシズ$$ is speeding up!」

stage0095_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$!」

stage0095_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「So, the Supreme Commander has fled...
　After all, for him, the name $$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　the Red Comet, must have been too heavy.」

stage0095_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「The name of the Red Comet, hope of Zeon
　and the Spacenoids, I shall inherit it myself.」

stage0095_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「And I will let $$アクシズ$$ fall to the earth.
　That is the world's true, rightful form.」

stage0095_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「That's exactly it, $$アムロ$$.
　I am the same as the Supreme Commander.」

stage0095_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$!
　You're a singularity too!?」

stage0095_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ too... a singularity...!?」

stage0095_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$桂$$
「Two singularities...
　Just like me and $$オルソン#50$$...!」

stage0095_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Now I understand...!
　What $$シャア$$'s plan really means...!」

stage0095_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アムロ$$
「A great branch point in history,
　the origin of the $$新世時空震動$$...」

stage0095_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$アムロ$$
「The Great Singularity is $$アクシズ$$!!」

stage0095_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Now, let us begin, $c...
　This is humanity's turning point.」

stage0095_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$レズン$$
「Damn it!
　Is this as far as I go!?」

stage0095_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$クェス$$!
　You shouldn't be riding a machine made for war like this!」

stage0095_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「No, $$クェス$$!
　That's exactly why you make enemies!」

stage0095_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$クェス$$
「You're still saying that!
　I decided to trust the Colonel and fight!」

stage0095_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Open the hatch, $$クェス$$!
　See my face, and you'll forget all that frustration!」

stage0095_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$クェス$$
「I hate kids!
　They're so pushy!」

stage0095_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「You're a kid too!
　And so is $$シャア$$!」

stage0095_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「As if any real adult would wage a war!
　Don't listen to someone like that, $$クェス$$!」

stage0095_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$カツ$$
「$$ハサウェイ$$!
　Get away from that Mobile Armor!」

stage0095_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$フォウ$$
「That unit is amplifying her urge to attack!
　As long as she's piloting it, she'll keep fighting!」

stage0095_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「We'll destroy that Mobile Armor!
　If you want to save $$クェス$$, that's the only way!」

stage0095_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$!
　Giving children a tool to kill with!」

stage0095_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Do you want to repeat $$ララァ$$'s tragedy!?」

stage0095_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Have you really sunk to such a pathetic man
　who can't even talk back, $$シャア$$!?」

stage0095_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$クェス$$
「I'm sorry, Colonel!!
　I'm falling back!」

stage0095_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
（$$クェス$$... please, don't fight anymore...
　You shouldn't be doing something like this...）

stage0095_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$カツ$$
「It's alright, Hasa.
　$$クェス$$ has ejected.」

stage0095_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
（$$クェス$$... please, don't fight anymore...
　You shouldn't be doing something like this...）

stage0095_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I'll settle this here, $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0095_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$!
　Still going on about that...!」

stage0095_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「The Colonel has nothing to do with this anymore!
　By surpassing a man like you, I'll break free
　from the doubt inside me!」

stage0095_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Hearing you say something like that,
　I can't afford to lose even more!」

stage0095_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Wake up, $$ギュネイ$$!
　Earth doesn't have room for us to keep fighting like this!」

stage0095_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$シン$$
「Get out of the way, $$ギュネイ$$!」

stage0095_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Like I'd let you through, $$シン$$!
　I'll be the one to stop you!」

stage0095_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$シン$$
「What's the point of a fight like this!
　You should already know about
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$!」

stage0095_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I've staked everything on the Colonel...!
　I'm sure he has a plan to turn
　this whole situation around!」

stage0095_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$シン$$
「Then I'll hear that magic trick
　straight from the man himself!
　By breaking through right here!!」

stage0095_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$クェス$$
「$$アムロ$$!
　I won't let you get in the Colonel's way!」

stage0095_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「This isn't a place for kids!」

stage0095_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$クェス$$
「If you're going to treat me like a kid like that,
　then act like a proper adult!」

stage0095_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$クェス$$
「You and the Colonel are both so selfish!
　Not caring at all about anyone around you,
　just getting worked up on your own!」

stage0095_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You might be right, $$クェス$$...」

stage0095_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's exactly why I have to
　hear the truth from him!」

stage0095_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm getting through here, $$クェス$$!」

stage0095_04:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$クェス$$
「Move it, Hasa!
　Now even you're getting in my way!」

stage0095_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$クェス$$!
　Right now, I'm taking away your power to fight!」

stage0095_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Everything else comes after that!
　The Earth, and us too, none of it can end yet!」

stage0095_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Stop it, Captain $$クワトロ$$!
　I don't want to fight you!」

stage0095_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$シャア$$
「Right now, I am $$シャア・アズナブル$$.
　I'm no longer the $$クワトロ・バジーナ$$ you knew.」

stage0095_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Being told that, you think I could just
　nod along and say 'oh, okay'!」

stage0095_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You're just too selfish, Captain!
　As long as it works out for you, you
　don't care how anyone else feels, do you!?」

stage0095_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't make excuses!
　I never wanted to see a Captain like
　that!!」

stage0095_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Captain, please always be
　the cool grown-up you've always been!!」

stage0095_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$タケル$$
「Please stop, Captain $$クワトロ$$!
　I can feel your anguished resolve
　coming through your machine!」

stage0095_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$シャア$$
「I see, $$タケル$$.
　So your power to sense an opponent's
　will is something like a Newtype's.」

stage0095_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$シャア$$
「But that alone won't let anyone move
　forward! Think about what you yourself
　should do about the will you sensed!」

stage0095_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then come!
　Fight me for what you believe in!」

stage0095_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$タケル$$
「Captain $$クワトロ$$... no, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　My fight is to stop you!」

stage0095_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$タケル$$
「To protect the lives of everyone
　living on Earth, I will fight you!」

stage0095_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$正太郎$$!
　No matter who the opponent is, showing
　no mercy to evil is who you are!」

stage0095_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$シャア$$
「Stay true to your own justice!
　That's what I want for you too!」

stage0095_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But...!
　But I don't want to fight you!
　Are you really evil, Captain $$クワトロ$$!?」

stage0095_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$シャア$$
「Find that out for yourself!
　By fighting me!」

stage0095_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$正太郎$$
「...Let's do this, $$鉄人$$!
　We'll stop Captain $$クワトロ$$ together!」

stage0095_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$正太郎$$
「And we'll find out!
　What the Captain is fighting for!」

stage0095_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$シャア$$
「Seems I need no extra words with you.」

stage0095_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$キリコ$$
「If that's what you want, I'll take you on.
　I'm sick to death of fighting.」

stage0095_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's fine, $$キリコ$$.
　I feel the same way.」

stage0095_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's exactly why I'll overcome it...!
　Causality... a fate someone else decided!」

stage0095_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$桂$$
「You're too serious, Captain $$クワトロ$$!
　You're shouldering the singularity's burden
　all on your own way too much!」

stage0095_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$シャア$$
「Coming from you, I have no reply.」

stage0095_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$桂$$
「Don't screw around!
　Weren't Captain $$アムロ$$ and the rest of
　us good enough to talk to!?」

stage0095_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$桂$$
「And another thing!
　Whatever future you glimpsed during the
　$$新世時空震動$$, you'll pay for choosing war!」

stage0095_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$シャア$$
「Whatever others may say of me, I believe
　I did everything I could. That much,
　at least, I'll say with pride.」

stage0095_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's why I cannot retreat!
　I will drop $$アクシズ$$!」

stage0095_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$桂$$
「So it's our pride against yours, is it!
　Then there's no way I'm backing down
　either!」

stage0095_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$桂$$
「This isn't some trick played on us by
　someone else this time! If we're both
　serious, I can't afford to lose either!」

stage0095_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$シャア$$
「Still calling me by that name!?」

stage0095_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　This is so I can break away from you!」

stage0095_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Even if the reason you rose up
　is that you glimpsed a future of despair...
　No, that's exactly why I can't forgive you!」

stage0095_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Why didn't you tell us about that!?」

stage0095_04:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you had, we might have found some
　way other than starting a war!」

stage0095_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You haven't changed since you were the Red
　Comet of the $$一年戦争$$! Moving alone, just
　for your own ends...!」

stage0095_04:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't think you can change the world
　that way, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!」

stage0095_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$シャア$$
「...You're right, $$カミーユ$$.
　Perhaps I overestimated myself...」

stage0095_04:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's why I'll show you!
　That you're powerless!」

stage0095_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$シャア$$
「But I have pride of my own!
　I still cannot afford to lose to you!」

stage0095_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Here I come, $$シャア$$!
　Hand over the mission you've been
　carrying, to us as well!」

stage0095_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$シャア$$
「So this moment has finally come, $$アムロ$$...!」

stage0095_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I understand now...!
　You mean to settle things with me
　to break free of your past!」

stage0095_04:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$シャア$$
「As one who has seen a future of despair,
　I must guide humanity...!」

stage0095_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$シャア$$
「But before that, $$アムロ$$...!
　I'll defeat you, and surpass the man
　I've been until now!」

stage0095_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't get so full of yourself, $$シャア$$!
　Humanity's future isn't light enough
　for one man alone to carry!」

stage0095_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then do you have the resolve to shoulder
　it together with me!?」

stage0095_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm saying the very idea that one person
　should carry the world is arrogance itself!」

stage0095_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Each person's future belongs to them alone!
　All we can do is protect it!」

stage0095_04:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$シャア$$
「Hearing you say those words,
　I can go back to being just one man...!」

stage0095_04:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$シャア$$
「Let's settle this, $$アムロ$$!
　This is the last battle between us!」

stage0095_04:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$!
　I'm the one who'll stop you!!」

stage0095_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　You're trapped by the future $$ゼロ$$ showed you.」

stage0095_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$シャア$$
「The future can be changed.
　I fight because I believe that.」

stage0095_04:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But no one has the right to make
　someone else unhappy for that.」

stage0095_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then tell me, $$ヒイロ$$...!
　How can I possibly lead every last
　person to happiness!」

stage0095_04:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That's not for you or me to decide.」

stage0095_04:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What we should do is eliminate unhappiness...
　the enemies of peace.」

stage0095_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$...
　We will stop you with our own hands...!」

stage0095_04:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$シン$$
「Captain $$クワトロ$$!
　I'll keep the promise from that day, now!」

stage0095_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$シン$$
「That worst future we saw on the Moon that day...
　If Captain $$アムロ$$ and you ever fought,
　$$カミーユ$$ and I swore we'd stop you...!」

stage0095_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$シャア$$
「I am $$シャア・アズナブル$$ now...
　Not $$クワトロ・バジーナ$$.」

stage0095_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$シャア$$
「But I'm grateful for your feelings.
　You've grown strong, $$シン$$.」

stage0095_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$シン$$
「I'll stop you with that strength!
　That's how I'll repay you for guiding me!」

stage0095_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$シン$$
「Here I come, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　I'll stop you and end this war!!」

stage0095_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$キラ$$
「Captain $$クワトロ$$!
　Even if you have your own way of doing
　things, we won't accept it!」

stage0095_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$シャア$$
「I knew you'd surely say that.
　That's why I rose as $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

stage0095_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$シャア$$
「And $$キラ$$... you should understand.
　That there are things that won't bend,
　no matter what anyone says.」

stage0095_04:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$キラ$$
「I've learned just how dangerous that is!
　Acting without ever using words fully
　only breeds needless conflict!」

stage0095_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$キラ$$
「Tell me your true intentions... your
　feelings! Showing strength alone
　changes nothing!」

stage0095_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$シャア$$
「If you understand that much, there's
　nothing left to worry about.」

stage0095_04:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$シャア$$
「I've already told you my feelings...!
　All that's left is for our resolve
　to clash by force!」

stage0095_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$シャア$$
「Come, $$キラ$$!
　If you have something you believe in,
　then stop me!」

stage0095_04:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$キラ$$
「I will stop you, Captain $$クワトロ$$!
　That's the fight I believe in!」

stage0095_04:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　What are you thinking!?」

stage0095_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$刹那$$...
　If you too have awakened as an Innovator,
　you should be able to sense my will.」

stage0095_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$刹那$$
「That's not the issue!
　I want to hear the truth from your
　own mouth!」

stage0095_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$刹那$$
「Knowing something and understanding each
　other aren't the same! Tell me in your
　own words why you did this!」

stage0095_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$シャア$$
「I'm glad a man like you is the
　First Innovator.」

stage0095_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$.
　You're just like $$アムロ$$.」

stage0095_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$シャア$$
「The way you live your life will guide
　humanity. So live as you see fit.」

stage0095_04:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$刹那$$
「People coming to understand each other
　through dialogue, and building a world
　without war...! That's why I'll stop you!!」

stage0095_04:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Do you really think the world will
　change through methods like this!?」

stage0095_04:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$シャア$$
「A boy who pilots the Unicorn...!」

stage0095_04:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Answer me!
　Will you destroy Earth as Zeon,
　the Spacenoids' god!?」

stage0095_04:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$シャア$$
「It's not the existence called Zeon that
　is a god. It's the potential within someone
　who finds hope that changes fate... the future...」

stage0095_04:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$シャア$$
「That is what a god is.」

stage0095_04:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$シャア$$
「It seems you understand that.
　It's to a human like that the Unicorn
　ought to have been entrusted.」

stage0095_04:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Don't try to dodge the question!
　What I want to know is...」

stage0095_04:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$シャア$$
「Find the rest of that answer yourself...!
　If you want a new era!」

stage0095_04:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If that lies beyond stopping you...!
　Then I...!!」

stage0095_04:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$葵$$
「I'm disappointed, Captain $$クワトロ$$.
　I thought you were a smarter grown-up
　than this.」

stage0095_04:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$シャア$$
「You overestimate me.
　I've only ever done my desperate best.」

stage0095_04:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$葵$$
「So this fight is your answer, huh.
　Then we'll deny it, head-on!」

stage0095_04:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$シャア$$
「So that's the conclusion your instincts
　reached. ...But perhaps I wanted that
　too.」

stage0095_04:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$葵$$
「Spare me the speech, Captain!
　I'm sure what you're doing is right,
　seen from some angle!」

stage0095_04:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$葵$$
「All that's left is you and us, Captain...
　and who wins!」

stage0095_04:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$シャア$$
「So your instincts have caught fire...!
　Come at me, Team D!」

stage0095_04:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$葵$$
「Here we come, Captain!
　With everything we've got...」

stage0095_04:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$バサラ$$
「War's a stupid waste of time!
　You must know that too!」

stage0095_04:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$シャア$$
「I suppose I'm the clown who has no
　choice but to do that stupid thing.」

stage0095_04:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$$バサラ$$
「That's ridiculous!
　What's the point of forcing yourself
　to do something you don't want to do!」

stage0095_04:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Your soul isn't something you burn
　for a thing like that, is it!?」

stage0095_04:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Heh... looks like you're out of comebacks」

stage0095_04:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$シャア$$
「Anything I say now would only sound like
　an excuse, in front of you」

stage0095_04:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Then here I go!
　$$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　I'll burn your Soul away!」

stage0095_04:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$アルト$$
「Captain $$クワトロ$$!
　You betrayed us!」

stage0095_04:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$シャア$$
「You and I simply chose different paths!」

stage0095_04:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's not what I mean!
　What you betrayed was our trust!」

stage0095_04:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$アルト$$
「No matter what happened,
　I never thought you'd choose
　a path like war...!」

stage0095_04:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$シャア$$
「Let's see if you can, $$アルト$$!
　Even your wings won't catch me easily!」

stage0095_04:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'll do it!
　To protect the lives of everyone living on Earth!」

stage0095_04:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Are you ready, Captain $$クワトロ$$!
　I'm dead serious!!」

stage0095_04:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Enough talk, Red Comet!
　Let's just show each other through action!」

stage0095_04:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Even with Earth on the line in this huge fight,
　I'm getting pumped up!」

stage0095_04:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$シャア$$
「With you as my opponent, it seems
　I'll have to give it everything I've got」

stage0095_04:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$シャア$$
「But don't think that even Getter
　can shatter my resolve so easily!」

stage0095_04:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Here I come, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　I'll beat you down to settle this war!」

stage0095_04:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$竜馬$$
「With everything Getter and I have got!」

stage0095_04:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$甲児$$
「Captain $$クワトロ$$!
　Stop this fight right now!」

stage0095_04:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$シャア$$
「And if I said I couldn't do that,
　what would you do?」

stage0095_04:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$甲児$$
「Obviously!
　Even against you, I'll fight to protect Earth!」

stage0095_04:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$シャア$$
「A man like you... even if the world changes,
　your true nature never wavers...」

stage0095_04:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$シャア$$
「I love the heart in you that hates evil」

stage0095_04:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$甲児$$
「I've had enough of you talking like you know it all!
　Being a singularity doesn't make you a god!」

stage0095_04:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$甲児$$
「If you want a fight that badly,
　Mazinger and I will be your opponents!」

stage0095_04:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's how it should be, $$兜甲児$$」

stage0095_04:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$赤木$$, is it...
　I expected a reaction like yours」

stage0095_04:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$赤木$$
「Forget about me!
　If you're going to think about someone,
　think about the people living on Earth!」

stage0095_04:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$赤木$$
「No matter what your reasons are,
　can you really hold your head high
　in the face of the lives you're losing!?」

stage0095_04:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$赤木$$
「And you call a man like that
　the hope of everyone living in space!?」

stage0095_04:r_7d0527803c131a6e.text:
$$シャア$$
「I intend to bear that sin!」

stage0095_04:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$赤木$$
「You don't need to be resolved to that!
　We'll rip that sin right off of you!」

stage0095_04:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$赤木$$
「Protect the people of Earth,
　and don't let my friends commit sins!
　That's what a hero of justice is!」

stage0095_04:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「For a man like you to have made up his mind...
　my words probably don't mean anything anymore」

stage0095_04:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$シャア$$
「And yet, it seems that doesn't mean
　you agree with me」

stage0095_04:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I made a promise about the future with someone.
　Naturally, it's a world overflowing with hope」

stage0095_04:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Nobody wants a world where countless lives
　are lost without even being told why.
　You must understand that too」

stage0095_04:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's a stale line, but I'll speak the truth...
　A person's life weighs as much as the Earth itself」

stage0095_04:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I won't accept a war born of resignation
　or compromise, nor the one who starts it」

stage0095_04:r_c0837a2b98000559.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then come at me without hesitation, $$ロジャー$$.
　I'll accept this battle as your dialogue」

stage0095_04:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'll thank you for showing my profession that respect」

stage0095_04:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　On a negotiator's pride, I'll stop you!」

stage0095_04:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「So, it's come to this after all」

stage0095_04:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'm disappointed, $$シャア・アズナブル$$.
　I thought you, of all people, would never make
　as foolish a choice as $$トレーズ$$ or I did」

stage0095_04:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$シャア$$
「Curse me all you like.
　But someone had to play the fool」

stage0095_04:r_69bf15620a355d50.text:
$$シャア$$
「It wasn't me that $$トレーズ$$ entrusted
　the future to... it was you」

stage0095_04:r_ae4d9169d6ff43a4.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「...I'll grant that Chrono and the Earth
　supremacists were a real threat, and credit you
　for striking them while you had the chance. But I won't accept you!」

stage0095_04:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「To affirm your methods would mean
　forgiving who I once was!
　That's why I'll fight you!」

stage0095_04:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's how it should be, $$ゼロ$$.
　A day will come when you take off that mask」

stage0095_04:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's not for me or you to decide!
　It's for the world!」

stage0095_04:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「And to protect the people who live in it,
　I'll stop you!」

stage0095_04:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$宗介$$
「As expected of the man called the Red Comet.
　Not a single opening...!」

stage0095_04:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$シャア$$
「You seem to be a well-trained, fine soldier.
　But that alone won't be enough to beat me」

stage0095_04:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Are you saying there's a factor
　that decides victory besides combat skill?」

stage0095_04:r_ae273a5479d64978.text:
$$シャア$$
「If you too are a member of $c,
　you must already understand」

stage0095_04:r_28066ae0934e6411.text:
$$宗介$$
「I see. It seems your spirit is still
　the same as when you fought alongside them」

stage0095_04:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$宗介$$
「But I too carry something on my shoulders...!
　So I can't afford to lose!」

stage0095_04:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$シャア$$
「Let me correct myself.
　You're not a soldier, but a warrior」

stage0095_04:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Titles don't matter!
　All I want is to defeat you!」

stage0095_04:r_263097ee015a04ab.text:
$$宗介$$
「Prepare yourself, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　I, with no needless ties holding me back,
　will strike you down!」

stage0095_04:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$$シャア$$
「So you're the one who pilots Aquarion...
　You really do resemble Apollo」

stage0095_04:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Don't you understand!?
　There are people who've fought,
　even throwing away their lives, to protect that star!」

stage0095_04:r_5135fdea02c6bd7b.text:
$$シャア$$
「What I'm trying to do is also to protect Earth」

stage0095_04:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What meaning is there in a method
　that takes the lives of the people living there!」

stage0095_04:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$シャア$$
「Even so, it has to be done...
　That's my mission as a singularity」

stage0095_04:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You're just like my father...!
　You're killing your own heart with the word 'mission'!」

stage0095_04:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm done watching people like that!
　I'll set you free myself!」

stage0095_04:r_f2655371e3ef7b59.text:
$$アマタ$$
「And for the sake of my father and mother's wishes,
　I'll protect Vega... and Earth!」

stage0095_04:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Why would someone who tried to protect
　the world alongside Captain $$アムロ$$ and the others
　do something like this!?」

stage0095_04:r_959b2fde0469959d.text:
$$シャア$$
「My feelings from that time haven't changed even now.
　I've simply parted ways with them」

stage0095_04:r_54d7a668750123ea.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Can't you go back to how things were?」

stage0095_04:r_586ac0e9503b5765.text:
$$シャア$$
「One can't return to the past.
　So people simply move forward
　on the path they believe in」

stage0095_04:r_1d13d9bb6a6d7818.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「I... don't know what happened
　between you and Captain $$アムロ$$ and the others,
　and I don't really understand what you're thinking」

stage0095_04:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「But I'll protect Earth!
　For the sake of the people living on that star!」

stage0095_04:r_9b8d839e83da7879.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's how it should be...!
　There must be meaning in you
　having arrived in this world!」

stage0095_04:r_95a0cdf4151c12f7.text:
$$シモン$$
「Stop this already, Captain $$クワトロ$$!
　Deep down, you can't really want this either!」

stage0095_04:r_855e82ce06693ee8.text:
$$シモン$$
「I don't know who you were in the past,
　but you're a man who was our comrade!」

stage0095_04:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$シモン$$
「A man like that wouldn't go and
　throw mud on everything he's done!」

stage0095_04:r_10cbf30c54cfe4fc.text:
$$シャア$$
「Even so, someone has to do it!」

stage0095_04:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$シモン$$
「Did it have to be you!?
　Even if it meant betraying us!」

stage0095_04:r_cc01b694a39de719.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then who will play the role of guiding the world!」

stage0095_04:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$シモン$$
「There's no need to push the villain's role onto someone!
　No matter how big the problem,
　if it's for the world's sake, everyone should think it through together!」

stage0095_04:r_fa54b106906131ec.text:
$$シャア$$
「...As I'd expect, Man of the Spiral.
　It'll be a man like you who forges the new age」

stage0095_04:r_64f86b30363f1f4c.text:
$$シモン$$
「I've just always thrown myself at things recklessly」

stage0095_04:r_c98d1f9a0e601947.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then stop me, and prove it!
　If you want to protect what you love!」

stage0095_04:r_afa4e4bac1376010.text:
$$シモン$$
「That's the plan!
　Here I come, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!!」

stage0095_04:r_c5f074a439f6c890.text:
$$シンジ$$
「So this is the Red Comet at full strength...!」

stage0095_04:r_b0aaf075b2a97a36.text:
$$シンジ$$
「A battle between people, different from fighting Angels...
　Yeah, I'm scared, honestly...」

stage0095_04:r_447e23c61fa29c56.text:
$$シャア$$
「If you have that resolve, you'll surely grow stronger」

stage0095_04:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm not fighting to hear words like that!
　I'm... fighting to stop you!」

stage0095_04:r_2b4d4dced3ef5a03.text:
$$シンジ$$
「The lives of the people living on Earth...!
　We'll protect them!」

stage0095_04:r_0c888ad00ef30dc4.text:
$n
「Are you going to keep looking down
　on humanity from above like that forever!?」

stage0095_04:r_941d9e3a330b1087.text:
$n
「What do you mean, 'singularity'!
　Just because you saw a future of despair,
　does that give you a reason to destroy Earth!?」

stage0095_04:r_bee2bfb994ca7365.text:
$n
「What you're trying to do is nothing but slaughter!」

stage0095_04:r_4d54e46ed7fd462d.text:
$n
「If you can't argue back, here we come!
　We'll beat you, beat Geminis,
　and protect Earth ourselves!」

stage0095_04:r_b23f4e273f76c5a8.text:
$$シャア$$
「Then I'll make sure you truly have
　the strength to carry that through!」

stage0095_04:r_2488b984097a7bdf.text:
$n
「How long's that big-shot act of yours going to last, I wonder?」

stage0095_04:r_6acc4cacd2cf56b6.text:
$n
「Prepare yourself, $$シャア・アズナブル$$!
　I'll put an end to the legend of the Red Comet myself!」

stage0095_04:r_131bea3d5d957e98.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「No need for extra words!
　I'll stop you and show you humanity's potential!」

stage0095_04:r_fc994d6aae0712cc.text:
$$シャア$$
「Let me thank you, $$ゼクス・マーキス$$」

stage0095_04:r_18ef8ab6be368d72.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「There's no time for words of thanks!
　As a warrior, I will defeat you!」

stage0095_04:r_176fd2544c64e83e.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「And the sorrowful war that's continued
　since $$トレーズ$$, I'll bring it to a complete end here!」

stage0095_04:r_ae2ea53f43e74074.text:
$$ブライト$$
「We both know each other's tricks...!
　At this point, it's just a battle of wills!」

stage0095_04:r_60e8a3284b8a113b.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All hands, don't let your guard down for a second!
　Our enemy is the Red Comet!」

stage0095_04:r_d4164c459c1c1165.text:
$$シャア$$
「Not bad, $$ブライト$$...!
　That's the spirit!」

stage0095_04:r_e745974656b70e6a.text:
$$オットー$$
「Our opponent is that Red Comet!
　Whatever you do, don't let him get close!」

stage0095_04:r_f794dabe545dc6ac.text:
$$レイアム$$
「Please calm down, Captain.
　Haven't we fought $$フル・フロンタル$$ many times before?」

stage0095_04:r_d4f3fe1e9bcf2590.text:
$$オットー$$
「Don't underestimate him, XO!
　The pressure $$シャア$$ gives off is on
　a whole different level from $$フロンタル$$!」

stage0095_04:r_59cb6a337266e5c9.text:
$$オットー$$
「That's exactly why, if we take him down,
　our victory is assured!
　We're bringing down the Red Comet, no matter what!」

stage0095_04:r_aab85855cbaf5596.text:
$$シャア$$
「I understand...!
　Even I understand, $$ララァ$$!」

stage0095_04:r_e5f4d0fca11502fa.text:
$$シャア$$
「You said it too...!
　No one dislikes something adorable!」

stage0095_04:r_47fd2ac2e2a8e945.text:
$$シャア$$
「That's exactly why I must shoot that...!
　That animal, I have to shoot it!」

stage0095_04:r_82218191e135e576.text:
$$マデューカス$$
「So, the time has finally come」

stage0095_04:r_c4e4b578079583c5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「From now on, this cosmos is our ocean」

stage0095_04:r_46c21ad643c64977.text:
$$テッサ$$
「And as long as this is our ocean,
　there is no defeat for us」

stage0095_04:r_04169fb070591784.text:
$$テッサ$$
「All hands, battle stations!
　This is the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$'s second maiden battle!」

stage0095_04:r_1be6bea3e5d25074.text:
$$テッサ$$
「All we need is victory!
　I expect everyone to give their all!」
